BiblicalUsage: Zabad means to confer, to endow, and it occurs once, in Leah's words at Zebulun's birth. In Genesis 30:20 she says, "God hath endued me with a good dowry; now will my husband dwell with me, because I have born him six sons." Leah reads her sixth son as God's gift, a dowry given to her.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Leah's word here is the right way to see children, because every child is a gift conferred by God, not earned, and Leah naming Zebulun out of gratitude is a pattern worth following.
